secrets.name: SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Hosted Supabase project URL (e.g. https://<project-id>.supabase.co). From Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → API → Project URL.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon/publishable API key. Used by the browser client (exposed as VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY).

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service_role secret key. Server-side only; used by SSR/server functions.
